olivia_cs: Heads-up: Mariner Health trial is hitting staging rate limits during their scripted demo. Renewal flagged as "at-risk" if the partner demo fails. Can we provision a short APAC window with a temp QPS uplift and allowlist?
olivia_cs: Request: env=staging, customer=mariner-health, reason=partner-demo, renewal_risk=high. Need 140 QPS for 2.5h and IP allowlist + header fallback.
samir_ops: Please post exact CIDRs + local time window. Also whether this needs peered egress or just proxy header.
olivia_cs: CIDRs: 203.0.113.240/28 and 198.51.100.128/28. Window: 2026-07-02 08:00 -> 2026-07-02 10:30 SGT. Primary: peered IP allowlist on staging. Fallback: header X-Cust-Mariner with value "mariner-demo".
kai_net: I can push net rules and schedule pre-warm. Proposed config snippet:
```
staging:
  allow_cidrs: ["203.0.113.240/28", "198.51.100.128/28"]
  header_bypass: {"X-Cust-Mariner": "mariner-demo"}
  temp_qps: 140
  window_utc: "2026-07-02T00:00:00Z/2026-07-02T02:30:00Z"
  prewarm_at: "2026-07-02T23:30:00Z"
  conn_pool_mult: 2.0
```
nora_se: Note: they use streaming and long prompts in the demo. Suggest max_tokens_per_request=450, prefix_cache_ttl=900s. Add model-fallback to a smaller footprint model if p99 > 500ms. Also set per-connection timeout to 60s to avoid stuck streams.
samir_ops: I'll create NET/OPS tickets and tag for CS lead approval since QPS>self-serve. Who signs?
olivia_cs: CS lead @frank_cs gave verbal ok on the call. I'll add him to the ticket for audit.
sys-bot: Change request queued: NET-11023, OPS-8001. Prewarm scheduled 2026-07-02T23:30:00Z.
kai_net: Kicking off KV prefix warm at prewarm time and bumping pool sizes. Monitoring dashboard: https://observ.redwood.internal/d/mariner-staging/demo-window
sys-bot: Allowlist applied to staging (prewarm) at 2026-07-02T23:35:12Z. QPS uplift scheduled for 2026-07-02T00:00:00Z UTC.
kai_net: Final switch completed at 2026-07-02T00:00:05Z. Observability: p95 ~115ms, p99 briefly hit 420ms for ~45s then normalized. No error-rate increase.
olivia_cs: Demo ran smoothly, partner reported no throttles. I'll capture feedback and update renewal tracker. Post-demo action: collect sample prompts and any >300ms traces for SE review.
sys-bot: Scheduled rollback at 2026-07-02T02:30:00Z UTC. Tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-11023, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-8001.
